summary: Spec fidelity (the brief): the approved brief names the refusals CI_ENV_MISSING and CI_WORKTREE_DIRTY (brief.md F2 detail l.97-98, F2 acceptance l.151-152, last acceptance line l.171) but atip/1 7.2.1 fixes fifteen conditions (INVALID REQUIRED NOT_FOUND EXISTS CONFLICT STALE EXPIRED DENIED UNSUPPORTED TOO_LARGE CORRUPT UNAVAILABLE FAILED INCOMPLETE TIMEOUT); MISSING and DIRTY are not among them, so atip_codenames_03 would fail. I AGREE with CI_ENV_REQUIRED and CI_WORKTREE_CONFLICT (code, registry, fixture, scenarios 06/07, skill, CHANGELOG and tests all use them, and both codes are in `canon schema --error`). The defect: the approved brief (sha256:fd7d0625...) was never amended and the texts of evidence.ci-run.06 and .07 were edited after approval (2a30f0ea4), so brief and scenarios disagree. Fix: the planner amends the four places and a human re-approves. Blast radius: documentation only; no code or record depends on the old names.
